{{Top|leg}}
A '''docucard''' was a form of identification that was used on multiple [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The docucards could be [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forged]] by skilled individuals such as the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Moplin Jarron]] who was based out of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He charged more [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for offworld docucards than he did for Tatooinian documentation due to the increased difficulty of creating a convincing forgery.<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>
